label: REST storage
description: monitor.port.json over the REST API: one data graph per operation, each a declared request plus the decision of what its status means.

removeMany.description: The business graph that fans one removal out per id and waits for all of them.

submit.description: The business graph that attributes and records.

recordAll.description: The business graph that records each draft. Nothing here says they move together: an upstream API is not something a transaction can roll back.

list.description: The business graph that routes on the filter.

digest.description: The business graph that composes the digest.

import.description: The business graph that reads the file and submits each row.

export.description: The business graph that lists and writes the file.

prepare.description: Reading the collection once is what readiness means for an upstream API: there is nothing to create, and a tree that cannot reach it refuses to serve.
